svg.title: PS-5 pipeline: program file to device kernel and CPU emulation
svg.desc: The crypto repository exports PS-3's straight-line program (pdp-slp/1, hashed). pdp_ps5_emit turns it into generated lop3 code. The same generated code is compiled twice: by nvcc as the CUDA kernel (never run here) and by a C compiler as the CPU emulation, which the parity driver uses to replay the PS-0 corpus.
svg.text: PS-5 on a CPU-only host: what was built, what was run, what was not
crypto: pdp_speedup export-program
PS-3 straight-line program, batch of 8 tasks
pdp-slp/1, SHA-256 recorded by PS-2 (l = 8..12)
pdp_ps5_emit (suite/cuda)
re-hashes, validates, one statement per gate
xor-and gate a^(b&c) = one ternary op (lut 0x78)
generated pdp_ps5_lL.h / .inc
n, l, gate counts, program hash; 65k..127k statements
PS5_DEF(K, PS5_XAND(PS5_W(a), PS5_W(b), PS5_W(c)))
CUDA kernel pdp_ps5_kernel.cu + pdp_ps5_device.cuh
wires are single-assignment locals; gates = inline PTX lop3.b32
1 lane = 1 bit of a 32-bit word = 1 pair; 1 thread = 1 job = 8 tasks x 32 lanes
hits appended with one atomicAdd per non-empty task
NOT RUN: no GPU, no allocation. Compile check only (see report).
CPU emulation pdp_ps5_emulate.c (same header, same .inc)
wires in one array, body split into chunk functions (host compilers)
gates: C operators (plain) or the bitwise lop3 model with its table
job loop replaces the grid; thread-private hit lists
RUN here: this is a CPU measurement, not a device result.
nvcc -O3 -Xptxas -v
cc -O1
Parity driver pdp_ps5_parity.c (host)
base points (rational lifts of V), transposed to blocks of 32 lanes
rows U+- = P +- R, exact; jobs tile every pair (i1, i2 >= i1) once
every hit lane confirmed, every exceptional lane recomputed (exact)
per target: full root set and verdict == PS-0; digests == PS-0's
self-test: 256 lop3 tables, every wire vs interpreter,
kernel masks vs scalar GF(2^n) formulas on forced-hit lanes
Frozen inputs
PS-0 corpus l = 8..12 (80 targets each), byte-identical copy + hashes
PS-0 verdict and root digests (baseline_v1/digests.txt)
PS-3 program hashes (ps2_scalar/README.md section 5)
hit records
